overview: Neferty Space is a modern NFT minting and management app on the Internet Computer blockchain. Users can mint NFTs with custom images, manage their gallery, and transfer NFTs to other users — with full transparent transaction history for every NFT.
features: Mint NFTs with custom images stored on-chain
Gallery view of all owned NFTs
Transfer NFTs to other users by principal ID
Full transaction history per NFT (mint + all transfers)
Liquid glass UI with fully customizable color themes
